reason: No object-level online catalogue exists at all. The Design Museum (London) publishes only an editorial 'About the collection' narrative page at https://designmuseum.org/about-the-museum/design-museum-collection (resolves 200 from /collection) — it is prose about collecting policy, donations, and the Boilerhouse Project history, with ZERO links to per-object records, no object grid, no 'browse/explore the collection' affordance. The site's only search (https://designmuseum.org/search, form action=/search, data-role=search-query) is a site-CONTENT search over editorial pages, not an object catalogue: querying object terms returns exhibition/marketing pages only — q=chair returned /exhibitions/women-fashion-power, /exhibitions/objects-of-desire, /venue-hire, /press-office, /design/design-museum-publishing (no /object/ or /collection/{id} records); q=poster/Anglepoise/'Jasper Morrison'/Kubrick likewise returned only editorial pages. There is no machine-readable object source on the museum's own infra: /wp-json (not WordPress — custom platform serving /static/css/base.min.css), /api, /collections, /our-collection, /the-collection, /explore all return HTTP 500; candidate subdomains collection./collections./catalogue.designmuseum.org and designmuseumcollection.org do not resolve (000); no sitemap.xml or sitemap_index.xml (404); no __NEXT_DATA__, no Algolia, no eMuseum/Axiell/Adlib/TMS, no GraphQL, no JSON-LD on the collection page (0 ld+json blocks). This is the exact 'editorial/curated story pages only, no per-artwork records with images' case the brief said to reject. Per the brief: no per-artwork records with images -> viable:false.
easy_source_found: None. Checked in order: (1) designmuseum.org/opendata, /api -> HTTP 500; data.designmuseum.org not probed as no DNS pattern and infra is a single custom CMS. (2) No GitHub org open-data dump for this museum. (3) Not a national-OA-API institution (independent charity, not UK national-collection API). (4) Not WordPress/Drupal/eMuseum/CONTENTdm/Solr — /wp-json 500, no /jsonapi, ?format=json N/A. The museum runs a bespoke marketing CMS (static asset paths /static/..., custom 500 error template) with no public collection API, no IIIF, and no object data layer of any kind.
probe_summary: Collection URL reachable (editorial narrative only). No object-level catalogue, no object records, no machine-readable object source on museum infra. All API/catalogue endpoints 500 or non-resolving; site search is editorial-only and returned zero object records for poster/chair/Anglepoise/Jasper Morrison/Kubrick. Nothing to scrape.
notes: Museum is the Design Museum, Kensington High Street, London (moved 2016 from Shad Thames to the former Commonwealth Institute building). It holds a real physical collection (~mass-production / contemporary design objects: furniture, product, graphic design, transport) but does NOT put it online as a browsable per-object catalogue — only the curatorial-policy page + occasional exhibition microsites. Even if a catalogue existed, the collection is predominantly 3D/industrial design (furniture, products, transport) which is out of scope; flat works (posters/graphic design) would be a minority. Skip permanently unless the museum launches an object-level collections-online platform in future. robots.txt is permissive (Allow: /), so blocking is not the issue — the data simply does not exist on their site. Probe done with both UA 'armin-museum-research/1.0' (also yields 500s) and a browser UA fallback.
